assumptions.choice: Donchian upper/lower bands computed from the highest high / lowest low of the prior `period` bars, excluding the current bar (bt.indicators.Highest/Lowest applied to high(-1)/low(-1))
assumptions.reason: Backtrader has no guaranteed built-in DonchianChannel indicator, so a custom one was implemented. Including the current bar in the window would make close[0] > dch[0] structurally impossible (dch would always be >= high[0] >= close[0]), so the classic breakout convention (band from prior N bars) was used to make the stated entry condition satisfiable, consistent with 'DonchianChannel using high/low bands' breakout systems.

assumptions.choice: Implemented option (B): a custom indicator outputting sin(2*pi*day_of_year/365) as the seasonal score
assumptions.reason: The fixed harness data feed only supplies Open/High/Low/Close/Volume; no 'seasonal' line is present, so option (A) is infeasible in this environment and the spec's own fallback (B) was used.

assumptions.choice: On the first bar a position is held, treat the 'previous_stop' in the trailing formula as if it were -infinity (long) or +infinity (short), so the initial stop equals close - atr_mult*ATR (long) or close + atr_mult*ATR (short)
assumptions.reason: The spec gives the trailing recursion (max/min with previous_stop) but never states the seed value; this is the natural degenerate case of the same formula and requires no extra indicator or rule.

assumptions.choice: When both the opposite confirmed signal and the ATR trailing-stop condition are true on the same bar, the opposite-signal exit takes priority (checked first)
assumptions.reason: Spec lists 'Exits' (opposite signal) before 'Risk management' (trailing stop) in that order; no explicit priority is stated, so the listed order was used to break the tie.

assumptions.choice: 'Reverse/close on the next opposite confirmed signal' implemented as self.close() only (flatten), not a same-bar reversal order; a new opposite position can then open on a later bar via the normal entry check once flat
assumptions.reason: Canonical default #2 maps 'exit/close' to self.close(); the spec gives no sizing/order-type instruction for a same-bar reversal, so no additional order mechanics were invented beyond the stated close action.

assumptions.choice: Trailing stop is evaluated with a manual close[0] comparison inside next() rather than a live bt.Order.Stop order
assumptions.reason: All entries and exits in the spec are 'confirmed on bar close'; a manual bar-close check keeps the stop check consistent with that confirmation timing, and the spec explicitly permits 'stop orders or manual close'.
